written: 2026-10-28, before Phase A's service change was made and before its diagnostics ran
about: What Phase A's diagnostics must show (research/value-scale-plan.md, Phase A): the request may state the scale (value_scale = auto, linear or log), the reply says how the file was read, and the automatic reading is unchanged. Not edited after the run: a difference is explained in the report.
tables: every bank table Step 1's D3 traced, on the same cells (a table above 2,000 cells drawn with the same seed); the tables the service refuses for fewer than 20 cells stay refused under every reading
pipeline: v4.1, modality prot, pipeline.run_projection, as D3
A0_baseline: run on the code before the change: the full reply of every traced table, as canonical JSON (keys sorted), and its sha256

every_table: the reply with no stated scale has the same sha256 as the baseline's
its value_scale has exactly the keys detected and transformed (no stated)
its summary (value scale, cells, genes matched, label levels, abstention reasons, top labels) equals D3's in research/notebook-outputs/value_scale_step1/report.json

every_table_and_reading: value_scale.detected is the automatic rule's reading (unchanged by the stated one)
value_scale.transformed is true exactly when the stated reading is linear
A2_stated_reading.same_as_automatic: when the stated reading equals the automatic one, the reply equals the automatic reply in every field except value_scale.stated
A2_stated_reading.refused: a linear reading of a table with any negative value is refused with an error that names the negatives; in the bank these are scope2_export, furtwangler_log2fc_nan and cptac_ccrcc_tumor (D1's negative shares 0.50, 0.15 and 0.34). A log reading of them is not refused.

A3_invariants_under_each_reading: under a linear reading, the values Stage 0 makes missing equal the zeros and infinities in the parsed table
under a log reading, Stage 0 makes missing only the infinities
mask sum equals the observed values in the matched genes after duplicates are merged
each z-scored gene's observed values have mean 0 and SD 1 (to 1e-4), or are all 0 for a constant gene
the encoder input (smoothed values and mask) is finite
the v4.2-style protein query (fusion.protein_query) reads the table the same way as Stage 0
every cell has a label or an abstention reason
A4_answers_by_reading: reported, not judged: per table, the cells whose answer (label, or abstention reason) differs between the linear and the log reading, and the answered count under each. Expected to differ most on the six linear tables today's rule reads as log (pxd064083_t, pxd064083_b, msv000099294_hmc3, msv000099294_microglia, furtwangler_batchcorr, furtwangler_batchcorr_norm), whose stated linear reading is the right one

A5_through_the_app.requests: service.app's handler in an in-process server, the request the site sends: value_scale absent, auto, linear and log
expect: a 200 reply equals pipeline.run_projection's for the same reading, apart from the app's warnings
absent and auto give the same reply
scope2_export with linear is answered 400, and the error names the negative values
modality rna with linear or log is answered 400 (the stated scale is for protein uploads)
an unknown value (for example raw) is answered 400, and the error names auto, linear and log
GET /api/status lists auto, linear and log
